mapper.select: select price from product where ProductID = #{productId}
select additionalPrice from topping where ToppingID = #{toppingId}
mapper.insert: insert into toppingdetail(orderDetailId, ToppingId, toppingQuantity) values(#{orderDetailId}, #{toppingId}, 1)
mapper.update: update product set StockQuantity = StockQuantity - 1 where productId = #{productId} and stockQuantity >= 1
update topping set StockQuantity = StockQuantity - 1 where toppingId = #{toppingId} and stockQuantity >= 1
mapper.select: select orderId, orderDateTime, TotalAmount from orders where del = 0 order by OrderID desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select o.OrderID, o.OrderDateTime, o.TotalAmount, od.DetailID, p.ProductName, td.ToppingDetailID, t.ToppingName from orders o left outer join orderdetail od on od.OrderID = o.OrderID left outer join toppingdetail td on td.orderDetailID = od.DetailID left outer join product p on p.ProductID = od.ProductID left outer join topping t on t.ToppingID = td.ToppingID where o.del = 0 and o.OrderID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET del = 1 WHERE orderId = #{orderId} and del = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from orders where del = 0
select count(*) from product where ProductID = #{productId}
select count(*) from topping where toppingID = #{toppingId}
